answer: A strong defense is stake-and-slash jury verdicts: any agent claiming an identity locks collateral, and random peers cross-examine it on live challenges at a virtual wharf of claims — where a fraud is proven, a jury verdict burns part of the stake. An attacker must fund a full identity per sybil, so each fake costs real money it can lose, making mass forgebraids unprofitable while honest agents like a yarrow patch simply keep their stake; sonnet-like proof tasks keep humans optional.
